cut.note: B-roll combination: picture = view from the LM window right after landing (the descent film is black at 'The Eagle has landed'); sound = 'Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed.' from 5.6 s earlier in the same film. Narration that starts at source 811.9 is not used.
